title: Basic Motions
description: Move without the arrow keys: h j k l, word motions, line edges, and file edges.

levels.title: Baby steps
levels.description: Put the cursor on the 'q' of 'question'. Arrow keys are for tourists: use j and l.
levels.hint: j moves down a line, l moves right a character.

levels.title: Skip the small talk
levels.description: Jump straight to the word 'server'. Pressing l twenty-seven times is allowed, but it will be remembered.
start_text: hi hello hey greetings the server is on fire
levels.hint: w jumps to the start of the next word.
